purpose: Local research only; no upload or push. Rules fixed before evaluating candidates.
selection: Choose eligible policy with highest median net Sharpe on validation at 10 bps; tie favors weekly_hmm. Freeze before opening audit. Report controls; do not select them silently.
risk: Strategy net equity high-water mark including fees. Daily close detection; liquidation at following observed close. Permanently latched to end of test; never reset annually. Never clip losses to 10 percent.
limitations: Previously examined years/assets are development data, not untouched holdouts. New audit assets provide only partial independence (correlated markets, survivorship). No proof of no overfitting or profitability. No parameters changed after audit.
model: Same fixed two-state Gaussian HMM as v8, three seeds chosen by training likelihood; no refit or hyperparameter search on validation/audit returns. Calendar review at first available close of each ISO week, executes next close. Trend uses trailing 200 observed prices including signal close.
